supplemental_items.interpretation: First int, lower_bound main opens at confirmation, clamp down to First then up to detector start. Read both anchor fields before guard. Anchor nonnull and int>=start returns source; repeated native int conversions, value normalization only after accessing source. No exact event check, upper bound, <=First guard, or null anchor value repair.

supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first ordered evaluation, provenance, implicit dependency, state or fallback beyond original category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: S13 earliest-equal full-main candidate first, then map containing confirmation. Remainder only when containing<start; start exact confirmation, end containing nominal end exclusive. Strict or equality replacement uses containing positional index rather than native Candle.index. Same containing main on all replacements; no per-row timestamp emitted.

findings.description: Remove universal pre-confirmation guarantee not supported by anchor and clamped-main branches.
findings.resolution: This gives earlier containing main candle on equal candidate price in the remainder branch. The anchor route tests only the clamped index lower bound, not its exact event time, and the min-with-First clamp can include a First main before the confirmation. The local helper does not universally prove absence of pre-confirmation data.
findings.recheck: W2 caller and W3 forensic review pending.

findings.description: Preserve evaluation order and explicit original-ordinal dependency.
findings.resolution: Convert both Blue ordinal attrs default 0 to integers then subtract one before either range guard. Test first range then second. Both referenced kind strings (default empty) must equal reset, checking first before second. Use the original supplied Blue list order, with no local validity/internal filter or identity check; caller ordinal alignment requires W2 verification.
